instructions.title: Enter the Terrain Rover
instructions.message: Climb into the rover through the ladder at the highland starting position.
instructions.guidance: Approach the rover ladder and press E to enter the vehicle cabin.
instructions.activity: Approach the rover ladder and press E to enter the vehicle.

instructions.title: Initiate Highland Ascent Mission
instructions.message: Access the main console and log the start of the final daytime ascent.
instructions.guidance: Open Mission OS and record initial mission telemetry.
instructions.activity: Approach Main_Screen_Trigger and press E to initiate the mission.

instructions.title: Check Water and Nutrient Supplies
instructions.message: Check remaining life-support water and nutrient levels (40% initial reserve).
instructions.guidance: Examine the resource dispenser and document consumption rates.
instructions.activity: Approach Water_and_nut_Trigger and press E to inspect supplies.

instructions.title: Check Highland Environmental Conditions
instructions.message: Verify daytime highland atmospheric temperature, pressure and UV exposure.
instructions.guidance: Approach the environmental console and save current readings.
instructions.activity: Approach Environment_Checking_Trigger and press E to record conditions.

instructions.title: Inspect Optical and LiDAR Tools
instructions.message: Inspect camera optics, calibration targets and LiDAR survey tools.
instructions.guidance: Verify all survey and imaging instruments are ready in the tool bay.
instructions.activity: Approach Tool_Section_Trigger and press E to verify equipment.

instructions.title: Drive to Sol3_Checkpoint
instructions.message: Follow the glowing navigation beam across the highland terrain toward the checkpoint.
instructions.guidance: Navigate the vehicle along the ridgeline to Sol3_Checkpoint.
instructions.activity: Drive the rover to within 50 meters of Sol3_Checkpoint.

instructions.title: EVA Mountain Photography
instructions.message: Exit the rover, approach the checkpoint viewpoint, and capture 4 to 6 photographs.
instructions.guidance: Walk to Sol3_Checkpoint, press E to activate the camera, and save at least 4 photos.
instructions.activity: Press E at Sol3_Checkpoint to open EVA camera and capture/save photos.

instructions.title: Return to Rover and Secure Photographs
instructions.message: Return to the vehicle and secure your photographs in the onboard database.
instructions.guidance: Approach the rover ladder and press E to climb inside.
instructions.activity: Approach the rover ladder and press E to re-enter.

instructions.title: Review Mountain Photo Gallery
instructions.message: Open the Mission OS to review your captured mountain photographs.
instructions.guidance: Examine the photo gallery tab in Mission OS to confirm image quality and quota.
instructions.activity: Approach Main_Screen_Trigger and press E to review the photo gallery.

instructions.title: Compile and Save Research Log
instructions.message: Document geological observations and photographic findings into the research log.
instructions.guidance: Complete the research log in Mission OS with observations from the ascent.
instructions.activity: Approach Main_Screen_Trigger and press E to save the research log.

instructions.title: Drive to SOL3_Finishing_Point
instructions.message: Follow the final navigation beam to the mission culmination terminus.
instructions.guidance: Drive the rover across the highland plateaus to the final destination.
instructions.activity: Drive the rover to within 50 meters of SOL3_Finishing_Point.

instructions.title: Generate Consolidated Final Report
instructions.message: Generate the comprehensive mission report spanning SOL 01, SOL 02, and SOL 03.
instructions.guidance: Open Mission OS, review the consolidated dossier, and generate the final report.
instructions.activity: Approach Main_Screen_Trigger and press E to compile the final report.

instructions.title: Final Water and Nutrient Level Check
instructions.message: Record final life-support resource telemetry (36% final water level).
instructions.guidance: Verify end-of-mission life-support reserves and document total consumption.
instructions.activity: Approach Water_and_nut_Trigger and press E to record final resource status.

instructions.title: Final Environmental Verification
instructions.message: Perform final environmental telemetry check at the mission terminus.
instructions.guidance: Record final external conditions and verify atmospheric stability.
instructions.activity: Approach Environment_Checking_Trigger and press E to complete final check.

instructions.title: Final Tool Inventory Check
instructions.message: Confirm all tools and sensors are accounted for and secured.
instructions.guidance: Perform final inventory count and confirm all equipment is locked down.
instructions.activity: Approach Tool_Section_Trigger and press E to verify final tool status.

instructions.title: Complete Journey & Final Departure
instructions.message: All mission objectives complete. Initiate final departure sequence.
instructions.guidance: Open Mission OS and click COMPLETE JOURNEY to conclude the expedition.
instructions.activity: Click COMPLETE JOURNEY in Mission OS to view the departure sequence.

completion.title: EXPEDITION COMPLETE
completion.message: All ELYSIUM IV mission objectives validated across SOL 01, SOL 02, and SOL 03.
